articles_of_faith.content_arabic: أن تؤمن بأن الله هو الخالق الرازق المدبر لكل شيء، وأنه الواحد الأحد الفرد الصمد
articles_of_faith.content_english: To believe that Allah is the Creator, Provider, and Controller of all things, and that He is One, Unique, Eternal, and Self-Sufficient.
articles_of_faith.content_luganda: Okukkiriza nti Allah ye Mutonde, Omuyambi, n'Omulamuzi w'ebintu byonna, era nti Yye Omu, Taliiko mufaanana, Omulamu olw'ensi, so talina ky'ayagala.

articles_of_faith.content_arabic: أن تؤمن بأن الملائكة خلق من نور، يعبدون الله ولا يعصونه
articles_of_faith.content_english: To believe that angels are created from light, they worship Allah and never disobey Him.
articles_of_faith.content_luganda: Okukkiriza nti bamalayika batondebwa mu luzi, basinzira Allah so tebamuviirako.

articles_of_faith.content_arabic: أن تؤمن بأن الله أنزل كتبا على أنبيائه، وآخرها القرآن الكريم
articles_of_faith.content_english: To believe that Allah revealed books to His prophets, the last of which is the Noble Quran.
articles_of_faith.content_luganda: Okukkiriza nti Allah yawandiika ebitabo ku bannabbi be, era ekisembayo ye Quran entukuvu.

articles_of_faith.content_arabic: أن تؤمن بأن الله أرسل رسلا لهداية الناس، وآخرهم محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم
articles_of_faith.content_english: To believe that Allah sent messengers to guide people, the last of whom is Muhammad (peace be upon him).
articles_of_faith.content_luganda: Okukkiriza nti Allah yatuma bannabbi okutuukiriza abantu, era omusembayo ye Muhammad (emirembe gibeere ku ye).

articles_of_faith.content_arabic: أن تؤمن بالبعث والحساب والجنة والنار
articles_of_faith.content_english: To believe in resurrection, accountability, Paradise, and Hellfire.
articles_of_faith.content_luganda: Okukkiriza mu kuzuukira, okubalirirwa, Ejjanna, n'Omuliro.

articles_of_faith.content_arabic: أن تؤمن بأن الله قدر كل شيء بعلمه وحكمته
articles_of_faith.content_english: To believe that Allah has decreed all things with His knowledge and wisdom.
articles_of_faith.content_luganda: Okukkiriza nti Allah yategeka ebintu byonna mu kumanya kwe n'obukugu bwe.

tawheed_basics.content_arabic: الإيمان بأن الله هو الخالق والرازق والمدبر الوحيد
tawheed_basics.content_english: Belief that Allah is the only Creator, Provider, and Controller of all existence.
tawheed_basics.content_luganda: Okukkiriza nti Allah ye Mutonde, Omuyambi, n'Omulamuzi yekka w'ebintu byonna.

tawheed_basics.content_arabic: إفراد الله بالعبادة، فلا يصرف شيء من العبادة لغيره
tawheed_basics.content_english: Directing all worship to Allah alone, not sharing any act of worship with others.
tawheed_basics.content_luganda: Okusiinza Allah yekka, so tosiinza muntu wala kintu kye kimu ku ye.

tawheed_basics.content_arabic: إثبات ما أثبته الله لنفسه من الأسماء والصفات دون تحريف أو تعطيل
tawheed_basics.content_english: Affirming the names and attributes Allah affirmed for Himself, without distortion or denial.
tawheed_basics.content_luganda: Okukakasa amannya n'ebifaananyi Allah by'ayogerera ku ye, nga tobyonoona wala okubigaana.

tawheed_basics.content_english: Major shirk (worshipping others besides Allah) and minor shirk (showing off in worship).
tawheed_basics.content_luganda: Okusiinza ebirala okusinga (okusinza ebirala okusinga Allah) n'okusiinza ebirala okutonotono (okweyagalira mu kusinza).
